The complete guide to Indian Railways trains between stations

Indian railways enquiry between two stations provides a list of all available trains running on a particular route. It helps travellers make informed travel decisions.

With a train enquiry between stations, done through a website or mobile app, the passengers can get an overview of all trains scheduled for their travel route.

Train enquiry between two stations helps passengers filter train options (as per their travel preferences) for a particular route and take the best travel decision.

Train ticket unavailability or long waiting lists no longer need to affect your travel plans. Comfortable intercity bus services offer flexible departure timings,
easy online bus ticket booking, and a smooth travel experience for your journey with safe and comfortable travel options.

Trains Between Stations FAQ

Q) How to check trains between stations online?

A) At RailYatri, we provide our users with the fastest, correct information on trains between stations in real time. You can check the Indian Railways train schedule here

Q) How can I check train status between stations at RailYatri website?

A) 1. Visit Railyatri trains between stations enquiry page.
2. Enter the 'From' & 'To' station name or code to get the updated train schedule.
3. Find the station name or code by just entering it's first 3 letters. You will see a drop-down list from which you can select the desired station.

Q) How is Indian Railway train enquiry between two stations helpful?

A) Indian Railway has been launching multiple new trains and older routes are being extended. Therefore, with the help of RailYatri's trains between stations information, users get a chance to look at all the available trains to any destination. Now, ticket buyers can make informed & smooth travel plans.

Q) Can I board the train after two stations?

A) Passengers are advised NOT to board the train after two stations. The railway authorities might mark you absent and push forward your confirmed train seat to the 'Reservation after Cancellation' (RAC) seat holder. However, here's how RailYatri can help you change train boarding point 24 hours prior to your departure time:
1. Go to Order History
2. Click on Ticket
3. Modify Ticket
4. Boarding Point Change
5. You are Done!

Q) If my city has more than one station, which station will I have to choose?

A) RailYatri is your one-stop solution platform that gives a complete list of IRCTC trains on its trains between stations page. Upon entering 'From' & 'To' stations name/code, you will get a list of all the trains that cover all stations of the selected two cities. You can select any one railway station as desired.
